data.taskBrief:
TASK BRIEF: Create a customer support ticket; updating a ticket is not covered by the supplied request (HubSpot CRM API)

FIT
  Partially. The supplied request creates a customer support ticket, but no supplied request updates an existing ticket. The create request is relevant; no requests were dropped as irrelevant.

AUTH
  Bearer token authentication using the Authorization header: Bearer <access_token>. The credential value is not provided.

BASE URL
  https://api.hubapi.com

STEPS
  1. POST /crm/v3/objects/tickets
     Params:
       Content-Type: string header — 'application/json'
       Accept: string header — 'application/json'
       Request body: the request schema does not define a body shape; the endpoint description says to send the ticket's properties. The saved example shows a JSON object with optional-looking `properties` (object, for example `{"subject":"Customer cannot log in"}`) and `associations` (array of association objects containing `to.id` strings and `types` with `associationCategory` strings and `associationTypeId` integers), but the required ticket property names and fields are not specified by the request schema.
     Returns:
       201 Created with a JSON object containing `createdAt` (date-time), `id` (string), `properties` (object), `updatedAt` (date-time), `propertiesWithHistory` (object), `archived` (boolean), and `archivedAt` (date-time). Error examples also show 500 responses with `category`, `correlationId`, `message`, `subCategory`, `errors` (array), `context` (object), and `links` (object).
     Threading:
       None

GOTCHAS
  - Resolve `{{baseUrl}}` to `https://api.hubapi.com`.
  - Send the body as JSON and include both shown headers.
  - The supplied request does not specify which ticket properties are required, so obtain the appropriate HubSpot ticket property names and values separately.
  - This request creates a ticket only; use a separate update-ticket endpoint for the update portion of the task.
